item.title: EplayerX 1.2.39
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 广告跳过切换为共享剧集时间匹配，按片源时长选择广告区间，并优化片头片尾标记的应用。 - 改善跨广告区间跳转的响应与稳定性，减少跳转后的等待。 - 优化播放预览缩略图与 ASS 字幕显示的稳定性。 - 重新整理设置分组和账号入口，简化界面文案。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Switched ad skipping to shared episode timings, matching ad segments to the video duration and refining how intro and outro markers are applied. - Improved responsiveness and reliability when seeking past ad segments, reducing delays after skipping. - Improved the stability of playback preview thumbnails and ASS subtitle rendering. - Reorganized settings and account access, with clearer interface text.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
